scope: root-supplied saved JSON evidence; strict structural/provenance consistency

manifest.frozen_binding: exact protocol_SHA/config_SHA/input_binding_SHA/implementation_review_SHA and nonempty environment object; frozen hashes are embedded in constructor
manifest.attempts: chronological descriptors {attempt_id,resumed_from_update,physical_source_kind}; first start0; later >=500 and divisible500; unique IDs
manifest.references: mapping role -> {path,sha256}; relative slash path inside evidence-bundle directory, .json only, no symlink traversal; raw bytes hash checked; max16MiB/document

required_global_roles.frozen_verification: saved root verification after latest death; exact run/binding/trainer SHA and four true revalidation flags, scope saved_root_observation_no_training_advance, UTC
required_global_roles.artificial_suite: original saved suite receipt; pass=true and implementation_review_SHA equals frozen review hash
required_global_roles.checkpoint_observation: saved root byte-hash observation after old processes died; exact published target, bytes, SHA256, regular non-symlink file, no tmp promotion, no deserialization for this hash observation
required_global_roles.publication_committed: required iff inventory says RECOVERY_CHECKPOINT.json exists; untouched original JSON bytes
required_global_roles.publication_pending: required iff inventory says RECOVERY_CHECKPOINT_PENDING.json exists; untouched original JSON bytes

per_attempt_roles.native_receipt: raw saved train_final.py.NATIVE_RECEIPT.json with actual wait returncode; integer zero or nonzero retained, never inferred from absence
per_attempt_roles.death_confirmation: root-saved independent observation matching nonce/PIDs/run/native receipt SHA and same host/process namespace; actual worker/supervisor/owned descendant absence; collector and UTC after stop
per_attempt_roles.archive_inventory: closed full stage snapshot except native_attempts, independent byte copies, full existing/missing mutable-path inventory, original/archive bytes and SHA equality, UTC after death
per_attempt_roles.physical_snapshot: raw PHYSICAL_PROGRESS or TRAINING_FAILURE; alternatively root-provided CHECKPOINT_METADATA with exact archived checkpoint SHA and saved physical_this_attempt
per_attempt_roles.previous_recovery_request: for each resumed attempt only, exact request JSON used by that attempt; constructor v1 exact13 fields
per_attempt_roles.prior_selected_publication: for each resumed attempt only, exact saved publication JSON selected by its incoming request; connects predecessor archive and request SHA

archive_record.constraints: full closed inventory includes all required mutable paths, native/used/log files, initialization/suite/start files, both journal paths and formal/tmp checkpoint paths, and all nine possible finalization outputs

physical_sources.PHYSICAL_PROGRESS: native_attempt_id/PID/logical_run_id/UTC, phase, current_update, last_completed_update, attempt_start_committed_update, known_completed_physical_operations_this_attempt, physical_schema_counter_lower_bound
physical_sources.TRAINING_FAILURE: same as failure source fields; updates is logical completed lower bound; resumed baseline comes from immutable incoming request
physical_sources.CHECKPOINT_METADATA: scope root_saved_checkpoint_metadata_no_training_advance; bound checkpoint SHA, native_attempt_id/run/transaction_version1/attempt_start_update/committed_update/publication_UTC, all_fields_after_completed_optimizer_and_log_commit=true, physical_this_attempt exact saved counters. Constructor does not open checkpoint.

outputs.name: EVIDENCE_VALIDATION.json
outputs.meaning: saved evidence hashes, selected transaction, prior chain, physical lower bounds/unknown intervals, explicit no-native-validation/no-process-access facts

usage_boundary: This is a local Windows preparation utility using native one-CPU/1GiB limits. No Linux-server execution or remote deployment is needed to generate a draft.
artifact_example: selfcheck_saved_records/attempt_001/fixtures/committed_target/EVIDENCE_BUNDLE.json is a complete ARTIFICIAL format example; it must not be used as actual recovery evidence.
trust_boundary: The constructor verifies raw saved JSON byte hashes and consistency. It cannot authenticate whether externally supplied native/PID/archive/hash observations were truthfully collected; root must retain their actual collection evidence. It does not deserialize or validate checkpoint tensors.
invalid_inputs: Missing required evidence and inconsistent hashes/PIDs/nonces/native exits/history/counters fail with EvidenceError before output directory creation. Existing output directory is never overwritten. Unexpected keys in prior request are rejected to avoid silently changing its interface.
